 Match Preview
 UEFA Nations League C - Game Week 5 Nov 12, 2026 - 12:45 Air Albania Stadium Albania host Finland at the Air Albania Stadium in Tirana in a UEFA Nations League C fixture that carries real weight for both sides.
 Rolando Maran's Albania come into this match sitting top of Group 1, looking to consolidate their position after a mixed run of results in the competition.
 Albania's most recent outing ended in a 2-1 win over San Marino, though they were beaten by this same Finland side just days before that, a result that will sharpen focus heading into this rematch.
 Finland arrive under Jacob Friis having lost their last Nations League fixture 1-0 to Belarus, a setback that has left them in third place in the group standings.
 The Finns had earlier beaten Albania 2-1 on home soil, so they know they are capable of getting a result here, even if the away fixture presents a different challenge.
